page.layout: One text block at full width, set in italic, running from the top of the page to the last line. Below it, at the right, the catchword "ROBER-". Between the text and the catchword, a woodcut ornament (fleuron), which is not text. Running head at top, with page number at top left.

p.i: 13.cap. ejusdem.Secunda est excusatio sui quod ad eos non venerit, á verf.17.cap.2.ad alteram usq; partem versus 3. cap.3. Tertia est exhortatio ad afflictiones patienter fustinendas, ab altera parte verf.3.cap.3.ad verf.usque 5.ejusdem capitis. Tertia epistolæ hujus pars est exhortatio ad vitæ sanctimoniam, á verf.1.cap.4.ad verf.25.cap.5.Et huic quoque epistolæ parti digressio inserta est de statu demortuorum, de adventu Domini, de resurrectione mortuorum, de tempore adventus Domini, á verf.13.cap.4.ad verf.usq; 6 cap.5. Quarta & ultima epistolæ pars est Conclusio, á verf.23.cap.5. ad finem usque epistolæ.

page.notes: The page has no printed heading. A woodcut fleuron (ornamental diamond-shaped ornament) stands below the text and is not transcribed. The catchword "ROBER-" carries a hyphen as printed. The long s has been replaced by s throughout; "verf." and "usq;" are kept as printed abbreviations. The text is set entirely in italic, with a roman "&" and roman "Quarta" capital where they appear in the scan.
